items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I called that Ragtime band, like Buddy Bowling.

ctx.x: Yeah, they just would, you know, different bands would name what they want to their band. Say like Joe Oliver had a band, you'd say Joe Oliver's Dixieland band or some other band would say Joe Galloway. Galloway's Ragtime band and all that.

Well, that used to be the old bands. Mm-hmm. The old bands out in the field, uptown. Yeah. The Ragtime. Ragtime band. I called that Ragtime band, like Buddy Bowling. Yeah, like Buddy Bowling. Olivier, Charlie Galloway.
